soundness_flags.label: oeq:case-margin-invariance
soundness_flags.one_line: Failure of endpoint invariance need not yield two qcase-compatible laws with different ratios or incompatibility with q: the substituted fiber may be nonempty and singleton with a ratio different from the original fiber, so a strict endpoint-difference/mismatch certificate is a missing residual branch.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:perenyi-collapse-boundary
soundness_flags.one_line: Failure of “CSE is constant on the face and equals CSEobs” can leave a nonempty face on which CSE is constant but differs from CSEobs; neither listed fallback covers that case, so add a one-law observable mismatch certificate.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:sharp-reciprocal-endpoints
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Fiber-wide period-two vaccine reference-risk positivity is an explicit additional restriction, not a consequence of observed-cell positivity.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Finite attained Charnes--Cooper endpoints are claimed only under ass:reference-risk-positivity; the extended sharp set remains the unconditional result.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states no-treatment-effect-on-exposure conditions, bounds the second-period challenge effect sharply in Theorem 1, and separately states a no-waning-of-placebo mean equality for its waning-ratio analysis.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 6, Table 1 and Section 5; pp. 7-8, discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines the time-to-event CSE as a ratio of subtype-specific challenge-risk ratios and identifies it with observed cause-specific hazard ratios under its stated assumptions; it says sharp bounds under weaker assumptions are future work.
The paper defines multi-variant vaccine-effectiveness measures and derives when they are time-varying under leaky and all-or-none vaccine-action mechanisms.

source_verification_receipts.version: Biometrics 74(3) (2018), public author manuscript identifying the final edited version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The marked-process model uses weighted estimating equations that allow time-varying vaccine efficacy and pathogen distributions under a specified active-surveillance exposure model.
The paper derives tight nonparametric treatment-effect bounds using latent response types and linear programming.
The paper constructs random sets for an identified set and known images, with asymptotic pointwise and uniform coverage conditions.
The paper gives calibrated-bootstrap projection confidence intervals for components and smooth functions of moment-(in)equality identified parameters with uniform asymptotic coverage.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair both open-question residual partitions: add a strict endpoint-difference certificate to the case-margin question and a constant-but-wrong-CSEobs branch to the Perényi-collapse question.

Give one nontrivial numerical K=2 instance with delta strictly between zero and one, a non-singleton sharp set, and explicit endpoint/sign dual multipliers; the present four-atom no-priming unity example only validates plumbing.

Specify an actual external exposure-measurement design and its transport target, distinguishing directly sampled exposures from surveillance of infecting strains; then state which sampling failures are absorbed by delta and which require a separate sensitivity parameter.
